source:
시방카 (시바견 차) 가질려면 30로벅스 내야함 특징:방귀부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:8/10)

그룹가입: 사자도리카 특징: 갈기로 악어도리카 물기 공격 막기 (속도:5/10 지구력:10/10) or 악어도리카 물기 (속도:9/10 지구력:4/10

좋아요 누르면 시방오토바이. (시바견 오토바이) 특징: 방귀 부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:6/10)

친구 초대하면 코닉세그. 특징: 비행기 엔진으로 하늘 날기 (속도: 7/10 지구력: 3/10)

나머지 차: F1 cars. (모두 속도와 지구력: 1/10과 1/10


게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

레이싱 코스: 5가지 1:탕후루 asmr course 2:두쫀쿠 asmr course 3:팝잇 asmr course 4:왁뿌볼 asmr course 5:키캡 asmr course
게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

image_prompt.text: Rails along the circuit edges that physically hold cars on the track at speed
Curved track elements forcing a clean direction change on the way round
A wide starting front of evenly spaced slots so every car launches side by side
five separate courses, each built out of one ASMR subject at giant scale — candy skewers, chewy dessert, pop-its, foam balls, and keyboard keycaps
a staging area at the start where the cars on offer are lined up

layout_placement.text: Grid slots at the start line, one per racer
Lap and split detection at intervals around the circuit

notes: Five named courses means five maps; the block carries one shape, so the count is recorded here.
Most of the prompt is monetization and vehicle stats — gamepass price, group-join, like and invite unlocks, speed and endurance ratings — none of which touch the layout.

open_questions.ask: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run.
How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow?

theme: Stylized / Toon — every course themed as a giant ASMR object: candy skewers, chewy dessert, pop-its, foam balls, keyboard keycaps

coverage_missing.ask: Laps around a circuit, or a run from start to finish?
Should the ASMR themes be literal giant objects you drive over, or just the colour scheme of a normal track?

answers.ask: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run.
answers.answer: 각 ASMR 코스는 한 바퀴를 도는 랩 서킷으로 만들고, 레이스는 1랩 완주 방식으로 해주세요.

answers.ask: How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow?
answers.answer: 한 랩은 작은 맵에서 약 1~2분 안에 완주할 수 있는 짧은 길이로 해주세요.
